fact: The March 2021 SNDS2 document states Law 01.008 of 16 July 2001 is the legal basis of the statistical system, completed by Decree 01.273 (CNS, 2001) and Decree 06.238 (ICASEES statutes, 2006), and that the Prime Minister's Arrêté 046 of 18 July 2019 appointed the members of the National Statistics Council.
title: Développement de la statistique : SNDS2 2021-2025
